subject: Final follow-up: Redwood discovery + next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan@atlasops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery follow-up + next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency customer-facing chat (target P95 < 300ms) and predictable monthly spend.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows, prefer VPC/private deployment or dedicated pools; procurement timeline: target contract signed by end of Q3.
- Success criteria: consistent latency across peak 100 qps bursts, ability to pin model versions, and audit logs for data access.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send a draft mutual action plan + deployment options for your security and procurement teams (attached).
2) Marissa (cc) will loop in our solutions engineer for a short technical deep dive if you want one.
3) If procurement wants pricing/commit templates I can share our Dedicated offer and a starter committed capacity option.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.pdf (draft) — covers milestone dates, responsibilities, and a proposed pilot scope.

Would love to hear which step you want to prioritize this week. If easier, happy to set a 20-minute follow-up with Marissa and me.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Jordan —

Wanted to close the loop on this thread — we haven’t heard back and I don’t want to clutter your inbox. If AtlasOps is no longer prioritizing this, I’ll close the file on our side.
